text.p: Transco Research Corp said Thursday it expects fiscal 1997 sales of $20 million and earnings of about $1 per share.

The company said it is manufacturing and marketing the first automatic machine designed to dispense prepaid coupons for making telephone calls and accept credit or debit cards as payment instead of cash.
Transco said it has an agreement to wholesale MCI Communications Corp prepaid telecard services.

It said it expects to begin shipping the machines in January, at a rate of at least 300 a month. Initially the machines will be placed in such locations as Amoco Corp convenience stores and Pathmark supermarkets.
